messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling deploy started for release v1.14.2. Feature flag `tipping_point` will be enabled to 5% in eu-west. Will incrementally ramp to 50% if telemetry gates pass. Reply with :thumbsup: to acknowledge.
maria: ack. quiet window is 22:00-02:00 UTC tonight, correct?
alex: yes, we planned the slow ramp during that window. pinning routing to v1.14.2 for this flag path.
samir: adding rollback criteria: if p95 latency increases >200ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows OR error-rate delta >1.5x, we pause and roll back to 0%.
maria: copying runbook snippet here:
```
# deploybot command
deploybot flag set tipping_point --pct 5 --regions eu-west --version v1.14.2 --note "gradual tip 5%"
# to pause
deploybot flag set tipping_point --pct 0 --force --reason "rollback/pausetest"
```
alex: telemetry gates: api_latency_p95, inference_error_rate, model_rolloff_score. We'll auto-insert canary alerts if any gate trips.
oncall-bot: NOTE: scheduled quiet window 22:00-02:00 UTC (today). Pager overrides suppressed for opt-in oncall. Use `oncall escalate` for immediate interrupts.
maria: small ask — can we only ramp users from cohort A (internal+beta) for first 10m before opening to broader 5% slice?
alex: yes, deploybot supports cohort targeting. changing command:
```
deploybot flag set tipping_point --pct 5 --cohort A --regions eu-west --version v1.14.2
```
samir: agree. telemetry owner: @alex for latency, @maria for quality regressions. If any gating metric deviates, escalate to #eng-oncall immediately.
maria: will run the smoke regression suite against v1.14.2 now, posting results in 10m.
oncall-bot: ALERT RULE (simulated): p95 latency in eu-west baseline 120ms -> watching threshold 200ms.
maria: smoke run done, no regression locally. ready to proceed with 5% cohort-A enabling.
alex: starting ramp to 5% now.
deploy-bot: Command accepted: `flag set tipping_point -> 5% (cohort A)`. Estimated completion 30s.
deploy-bot: Flag update complete. tipping_point = 5% (cohort A) in eu-west.
maria: monitoring dashboards... all green for first 10m.
samir: monitoring: no increase in inference_error_rate, p95 stable at ~130ms.
alex: after 10m, widen slice to 20% (internal+beta+10% external). will pause at 20% for 5m validation.
maria: copying the command I used if we need a quick rollback:
`deploybot flag set tipping_point --pct 0 --force --reason "emergency rollback"`
oncall-bot: HEARTBEAT: canary metrics OK. continuing.
alex: ramping to 20% now.
deploy-bot: Flag update complete. tipping_point = 20% (split cohorts) in eu-west.
samir: watchpoint: if p95 >180ms for two 5m windows, initiate rollback.
maria: getting a couple of small spikes but within noise. holding at 20% for 5m.
alex: decision: proceed to 50% after hold if still OK. tagging product for FYI: @product (via webhooks).
maria: FYI posted in release notes draft: "Feature tipping_point gradual enable 5->20->50% in eu-west, rollback criteria included." Will finalize.
oncall-bot: Scheduled checkpoint at 1718203000 to confirm continue/rollback. Use `continue` or `rollback` in thread.
alex: continuing to 50% in 2m unless any objections. :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
samir: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled ramp to 50% queued at 1718203100, will execute unless instructed otherwise.
